title: Does a Doula Help the Partner Too? What a Doula Does for Dads at a Home Birth
card: Will a doula replace me? No. Doulas and a dad from our survey explain how a good doula prepares the partner, coaches him in labor, and helps him be the person his wife trusts most.
llms: What a doula does for the partner at a home birth: preparing him before labor, coaching him during it, and why she doesn't replace him, with an international doula's interview and survey voices.
